name: First Semester
source:
You've just moved into a new apartment. New city, new roommates, new start.

The university looks ordinary from the outside. Inside, it doesn't.

First Semester is an adult visual novel about identity, submission, and the slow unravelling of who you thought you were. Your new roommate Vanessa seems to know more than she lets on. The taxi driver who picks you up every morning has a very particular arrangement in mind. And the professor at that strange university? She has a curriculum unlike anything you've seen.

What begins as a simple commute becomes something you didn't expect — and can't quite stop thinking about.
